info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Streaming Subscriptions Cancel-v2-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscriptions Cancellation API enables businesses to efficiently manage their streaming subscriptions by canceling existing subscription agreements. This operation is crucial for service providers looking to remove users from their subscription lists, streamline invoicing, or adjust service offerings based on user preferences. Typically utilized by customer support teams and account management systems, this API endpoint allows for quick responses to user-initiated cancellation requests. Enhance your customer service capabilities by integrating this API to ensure subscribers can easily opt-out of streaming services as needed.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to cancel an existing subscription. Make sure to provide the necessary subscription details to successfully process the cancellation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel a subscription. It requires specific parameters depending on your subscription details and cancellation options. Ensure that all mandatory fields are filled out correctly to process the cancellation successfully.

200.description: The subscription cancellation request was processed successfully.

DeleteStreamingSubscriptionsCancelReques.description: Request body for canceling a subscription operation.

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the cancellation request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the subscription after the cancellation attempt.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation result.

audit.description: Audit information related to the cancellation request.
